_: Cyber Range stack duels (owner direction, 26 October 2026). The seven systems are the System Hub's; no others. A system is weak to the types it depends on in the real network. Numbers follow the rules doc: light 20, heavy 50 with 15 backfire, repair 25, counter 10 (20 under five seconds), super effective 1.5x, 12 turns, 15 s to pick, 20 s to answer.

Identity.about: Active Directory, Group Policy, tiered administration

Network.about: The L3 router, VLANs, DHCP relay

Resolution.about: DNS. A move type only; the zones live on the domain controllers

Authorization.about: RMF questions; asked only at the signoff checkpoint

why.Identity: Active Directory can't be found without DNS; Kerberos and certificates fail when time drifts.
why.Network: A network you can't see, you can't defend: flow and log questions expose it.
why.Trust: pki.sbd.test has to resolve, and VLAN 30 has to be reachable.
why.Visibility: Forwarding crosses VLANs; both run on domain-joined Linux.
why.Endpoint: Agents deploy through Group Policy and report across VLANs.

Drift.about: Your answer windows shrink from 20 seconds to 12.

Noisy.about: Your next pick is shown to the other side before they pick.

Isolated.about: You can't swap on your next pick.
